result.requestedCompany: Digital Realty Northern Virginia Hyperscale Data Center JV
result.rationale: TPG's 80% interest is through TPG Real Estate Partners (TREP), an opportunistic real-estate fund series rather than an infrastructure mandate. Under the fixed strategy rule the asset type does not override the vehicle mandate. Digital Realty retained 20% and operations; no qualifying infrastructure-fund owner was found. TPG and TPG Real Estate duplicate one interest.
